objective_metrics: Compare raw outputs under the same case labels and common schema/behavior checks; separately report each implementation's actual delivery pass rate.
constraints: 12 synthetic cases, one generation per variant per stage; exploratory comparison, not population accuracy or clinical effect.
No prompt changes, retries, re-generation, or case removal after seeing outputs.
Invalid/incomplete calls stay in denominators and cost totals; subjective score is 0 only when no readable output, with reason recorded.
Input/card contexts are fixed across variants; this tests the prompt-strategy change, not RAG vs no RAG.
